<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. XV.|ACCORDING TO S. MARKE.|129 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>began to require according as alvvaies he did vnto them. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=9}}† And Pilate ansvvered them, and said, VVil you that I release to you the King of the Ievves? {{verse|chapter=15|verse=10}}† For he knevv that the cheefe Priests for enuy had deliuered him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=11}}† But the {{sup|‖}} cheefe Priests moued the people, that he should release Barabbas rather to them. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=12}}† And Pilate againe ansvvering, said to them, VVhat vvil you then that I doe to the King of the Ievves? {{verse|chapter=15|verse=13}}† But they againe cried, Crucifie him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=14}}† And Pilate said to them, VVhy, vvhat euil hath he done? But they cried the more, Crucifie him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=15}}† And Pilate vvilling {{sup|‖}} to satisfie the people, released to them Barabbas, and deliuered {{sc|Iesvs}}, hauing vvhipped him, for to be crucified.

{{verse|chapter=15|verse=16}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 19, 2.''}}* the souldiars led him into the court of the Palace, and they call together the vvhole band: {{verse|chapter=15|verse=17}}† and they clothe him in purple, and platting a crovvne of thornes, they put it vpon him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=18}}† And they began to salute him, Haile King of the Ievves. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=19}}† And they smote his head vvith a reede: and they did spit on him. and bovving the knees, they adored him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=20}}† And after they had mocked him, they stripped him of the purple, and put on him his ovvne garments, and they leade him forth to crucifie him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=21}}† And they forced a certaine man that passed by, Simon a Cyrenêan comming from the countrie, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to take vp his crosse. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=22}}† And they bring him into the place Golgotha, vvhich being interpreted is, ''The place of Caluarie''. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=23}}† And they gaue him to drinke vvine mingled vvith myrrhe: and he tooke it not.

{{verse|chapter=15|verse=24}}† And crucifying him, they deuided his garments, casting lottes vpon them, vvho should take vvhich. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=25}}† And it vvas the third houre, and they crucified him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=26}}† And the title of his cause vvas superscribed, {{sc|King of the iewes}}. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=27}}† And vvith him they crucifie tvvo theeues: one on the right hand, and an other on his left. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=28}}† And the Scripture vvas fulfilled that saith, ''And vvith the vvicked he vvas reputed''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 53, 12.''}} {{verse|chapter=15|verse=29}}† And they that passed by, blasphemed him, vvagging their heades, and saying, Vah, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`thou that destroiest''}}`he that destroieth' the temple, and in three daies {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`buildest''}}`buildeth' it': {{verse|chapter=15|verse=30}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ So Heretikes say of the B. Sacrament, If it be Christ, let him saue him self from al iniuries.}}∷ saue thy self, comming dovvne from the crosse. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=31}}† In like maner also the cheefe Priests mocking, said vvith the Scribes one to an other, He saued others, him self he can not saue. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=32}}† Let Christ the king of Israel come dovvne novv from the crosse: that vve may see and beleeue. And they that vvere crucified vvith him, railed at him.<noinclude>{{rh||R|And}}</noinclude>
